## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| reduction | `reduction` | Choice | `mean` | `mean`, `sum`, `none` | The run | Reduction. |
| pos_weight | `pos_weight` | Number | `1.0` |   | The run | Positive-class weight. |
| label_smoothing | `label_smoothing` | Number | `0.0` | `0-0.99` | The run | Trains on target x (1 - e) + e / 2 instead of hard 0 / 1 targets (the two-class form of CrossEntropy label smoothing); 0 turns it off. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: BCEWithLogits is a training loss node; PipelineExecutor loss execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as the loss |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
